construction: Defined in tools/corpus/make_toy_instances.m and written by Gurobi (gurobi_write, MPS), then its one-line "OBJSENSE MAX" rewritten as the two-line form "OBJSENSE" / "    MAX" (MOSEK 11.2 rejects the one-line form with error 1100 at the next line); read back by gurobi_read and by MOSEK (mosekopt read), both equal to the definition.
derivation: Maximise x1 + 2 x2 subject to x1 + x2 <= 4, x1 + 3 x2 <= 6, x >= 0. The feasible polygon has vertices (0, 0), (4, 0), (0, 2) and (3, 1) (the two rows active: subtracting gives 2 x2 = 2). Objective values 0, 4, 4, 5: the maximum 5 is attained only at (3, 1), since every other vertex is strictly smaller.
